people.name: Asahel
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner

people.name: Bethlehem
people.line: City of David's birth and Jesus' birth.

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: They took up Asahel, and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.
translations.bsb: And they took Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb in Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night and reached Hebron at daybreak.
translations.kjv: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
translations.asv: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Beth-lehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and the day brake upon them at Hebron.
